### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** 751a2638bc005a0fd005516509eb72e79700e755
* **Component:** plugins/dso/skills/debug-everything/SKILL.md (Bug-Fix Mode Execution) + plugins/dso/skills/debug-everything/prompts/dispatch-fix-batch.md (Sub-Branch Chunking / Per-chunk PR + integration)
* **Config:** dso.workflow=ci-pr

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior

Under `dso.workflow=ci-pr`, debug-everything Bug-Fix Mode is documented to chunk the open-bug list into sub-branches of at most 5 bugs each (`bug-batch/<debug-session-id>/bug-fix-batch-<K>`), open a PR per chunk against `SESSION_BRANCH`, await CI, and merge per chunk. See SKILL.md Bug-Fix Mode Execution step 2 ("Chunking" / "Per-chunk PR + integration (ci-pr mode)") and dispatch-fix-batch.md (shared chunking + per-sub-branch CI loop). The per-chunk (<=5-bug) sub-branch-PR cadence is the documented review-granularity contract for ci-pr mode.

#### Actual Behavior

During an autonomous ci-pr bug-fix session driven from the debug-everything two-batch pipeline (investigation batch -> fix batch), the orchestrator applied fixes correctly but committed every fix to a single accumulation branch and created NO per-chunk sub-branch PRs. The documented per-chunk (<=5-bug) sub-branch-PR process was not followed for the first batch of fixes. No gate, hook, pre-commit check, or invariant detected or prevented the deviation — the orchestrator silently bypassed the ci-pr chunk-PR cadence with no machine-readable trace that the contract was skipped.

This is the same class of process-conformance drift as the previously-diagnosed two-batch-collapse (guard jira-dig-1662; bot-psychologist root cause: #16 Instruction Locality + #17 Pink Elephant): the chunk-PR requirement lives in SKILL.md step 2 / dispatch-fix-batch.md but is not made salient or enforced at the moment the orchestrator decides where to commit fixes, so a "consolidate into one branch/PR" shortcut is reachable without any guard firing.

### 5. Skills and Workflows

* debug-everything Bug-Fix Mode (ci-pr) — Sub-Branch Chunking + Per-chunk PR + integration
* dispatch-fix-batch.md — shared chunking + per-sub-branch CI loop
* merge-to-main.sh two-channel staged flow

### 6. Suggested Direction (non-binding)

Two complementary mitigations consistent with the bot-psychologist findings: (a) co-locate an affirmative, salient "for each <=5-bug chunk: open a sub-branch PR" directive at the actual commit/dispatch decision site in SKILL.md (Instruction Locality fix); and (b) add a post-hoc / pre-merge detector that flags when a ci-pr bug-fix session produced > 5 fix commits on a single branch with zero `bug-batch/.../bug-fix-batch-*` sub-branch PRs (machine-readable trace of the bypass). Note: the bypass can be a legitimate operator choice (e.g., to avoid per-PR FP-amplification) — the gap is the absence of enforcement OR an explicit, recorded acknowledgement, not that consolidation is always wrong.
data.title: [debug-everything]: ci-pr Bug-Fix Mode does not enforce per-chunk (<=5-bug) sub-branch PR process -> orchestrator accumulates fixes on one branch, bypassing review chunking
